# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.8 Worker 2: regional industries, employment systems and the Slot 89 pulse (oe_ind_ / oe_emp_ / oe_ind2_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v118_industry_employment.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Fallback for Slot 89 when the scheduler's host (BYZ) is gone: same chain as the other late slots.
# Deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_ind2_ran_m.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_ind2_fallback_pulse
		oe_ind2_country_quarterly
	}
}

oe_ind2_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_ind2_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 4
			current_month = 7
			current_month = 10
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = VEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } tag = CHI }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } tag = MNG }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:MNG } tag = TUR }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_mfg_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

# Players and great powers, once a quarter (the month test comes first, so other months cost one comparison).
oe_ind2_country_quarterly = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_month = 2
			current_month = 5
			current_month = 8
			current_month = 11
		}
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ind2_country_tick = yes
	}
}
